verdict.rationale: Custom renderers are a fair axis for a UI framework, but the evidence pack never documents a custom renderer API or any non-DOM rendering target. The generic 'cross-platform' tagline and a community mention of Ionic mobile apps do not show the component model targeting non-browser platforms through custom renderers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write custom renderers so the framework's component model can target platforms other than the browser DOM
